summary: Design attention through foreground, focal action and background separation instead of relying solely on glow or dark exposure.
objective: The focal action stays visible throughout the move, text remains readable and dramatic darkness does not hide the mechanism being explained.
intent_signals: Direct attention with framing light and a purposeful reveal
example_prompts: Stage a cinematic reveal of a mechanical watch, then let me inspect its moving parts.

principles: Design attention through foreground, focal action and background separation instead of relying solely on glow or dark exposure.
This is an authored creative proposal, not a historical definition, fixed template or required rendering library.
implementation: Arrange depth layers and purposeful negative space around the hero silhouette; keep foreground shapes from blocking required actions.
Use motivated-looking key and accent lights with a chosen contrast range; retain detail needed to understand the scene.
Plan a revealing camera move or hold, with a stable inspection view available for interactive tasks; time visual emphasis around a meaningful action.
observable_checks: The focal action stays visible throughout the move, text remains readable and dramatic darkness does not hide the mechanism being explained.
Inspect the selected view and an alternate view at the intended output size before accepting the treatment.

known_limits: Proposed art direction only; no rendered artifact, runtime improvement or perceptual validation has been observed for this record.
Appearance choices do not certify factual geometry, material measurements or simulated behavior.
creative_affordances: Combine with photorealistic, stylized or miniature subjects; cinematic is staging rather than a promise of a specific rendering technology.
